items.title: Millionaire Hero
items.creator: Everbloom Games
items.description:
Save the city in this action-packed adventure! You play as a millionaire researching a new mind-controlling substance. When it gets stolen, the adventure begins as you race through the city in pursuit of the villain who took it.
* Highly produced adventure map
* A cast of unique animal characters
* Thrilling cutscenes & car chases
* One-of-a-kind combat
- SINGLEPLAYER ONLY

items.title: Zombie Apocalypse
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
Welcome to the Zombie Apocalypse! Equip yourself, explore the post apocalyptic town and fight the zombies! 

+Hard Mode! 
+Perfect apocalyptic town for Roleplay
+By FALL Studios & Artem Minenkov (artemin01)

items.title: Goats Camo
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Need a disguise that works in the mountains too? Gear up in Goat Camo skins with your favorite blocks and the head of the neutral animal mob. Role-play with friends as friendly creatures with bodies of calcite, copper cut, or deepslate copper ore blocks. Pretend to lower your goat horns and fade into the scenery.

+ 8 long jumping camouflage HD skins

items.title: Armor Glitches
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Yes, you can still be perfectly protected with imperfect protection. Just try it and see with Armor Glitches skins. Role-play with friends in shoddy suits, defective plates, and faulty helmets as you defend yourself against all enemies. Flaws are not always bad, sometimes they can make you stronger!

+ 8 buggy body armor-clad HD skins

items.title: Pirate Parrots
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Ahoy matey! Become a buccaneer’s best friend in colorful Pirate Parrots skins. Role-play with friends while you fly around the ocean and return to your perch on the pirate ship. Talk like a human in a tricorne hat and eye patch or squawk like the beautiful bird you are! Sail far and wide as you search the seas for treasure.

+ 8 finely feathered HD skins

items.title: Lucky Block Survival
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Craft and open your Lucky Blocks and get the best loot to help you on your way to survival. But beware, the Lucky Blocks can also be unlucky which can end badly for you.

+ Survival spawn included
+ 100 different Lucky Block outcomes

Created by Block Studios and Mine-North

items.title: Super Cute Animal Treehouse
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Incredible cute animals are waiting for you! Play with them in a huge treehouse and explore the colorful world of your super cute friends.

+ 10 super cute animals
+ Massive Treehouse
+ Cute Furniture
+ Vehicles
+ Super cute textures

items.title: Neon Trends
items.creator: DogHouse
items.description:
Always wanted to outshine your friends with your skin? Then this is your chance! The special thing about them are the neon colors, which give the impression that they glow in the dark.

-Includes 12 different skins
-Perfect for roleplay
-have fun!

items.title: Power Armors
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
We have the technology! Feel the strength of our power armors! Hop in and experience the super ride! Do what you've always wanted. Fly. Dive. Crush. Become the hero you've always wanted to be!

- 12 roleplay skins!
- Futuristic, armor attire inspired by technology and fantasy!

items.title: Princess Mega Mansion
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
Every princess needs a mega mansion! They also need their very own flying rainbow unicorn!

- Flying unicorn!
- Huge mansion!
- Horse and carriage!
- Swimming pool!
- Rooftop farm!
- Nether room! Storage room!
- Princess themed!

items.title: DragonFire 2 : Nations
items.creator: Spectral Studios
items.description:
The next edition in the DragonFire series is here! This is our BIGGEST map to date, featuring:

- 26 dragons to collect!
- Over 30 different original mobs to fight, tame and discover!
- Explore countless secrets across 6 uniquely themed land masses!
- Start your own nation, alone or with your friends!
- Custom furniture to kit out your nations!

How will YOU rule?

items.title: Auto Miners
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: Craft machines that automatically mine for you! Auto miners let you take your mining to the next level. Place them down and watch them mine without doing a thing! Then check their inventories and take your resources!

items.title: OP Ruins
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Lost in an old jungle, this temple houses thousands of valuable riches for you to plunder!

- The lower level includes stacks of rare blocks!
- Spawn next to a shulker box filled with enchanted netherite tools and armor.

items.title: Turtles
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
What's cooler than being a turtle? That's right, being a turtle in a random outfit!

+ 8 crazy turtle skins
+ Unique outfits

items.title: Robo Teens
items.creator: BBB Studios
items.description: I don't think anyone can be programmed to do homework, but it didn't stop the creators of these robotic teens from trying! Enjoy the teenage life with these robotic teen skins!

items.title: Pizza Party!
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Throw a delicious pizza party and invite your friends!
Roleplay as the pizza chef, a delivery person, even an actual pepperoni pizza, and more!

+ 14 skins!
+ 2 free skins!
+ Includes derpy pizza skins!

items.title: Bandits
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description:
Time for you to look like a bandit or cop! Which will you choose?
These skins are perfect for your roleplay maybe prison break adventures!

items.title: Neon Demons
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description: Spooky, scary, vibrant and so much more! These skins are perfect for your neon mob adventures!

items.title: Mob Hoodies HD
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description: These cute teen styles are inspired by some of the game's favorite mobs! Dress as a classic creeper, or wear an enderhoodie outfit!

items.title: Football Match
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
How talented are you at football? Well, now it's time to showcase your skills because football is coming to Minecraft! Start the match now and show your friends who is better at football!

+ Realistic stadium ambiance
+ Realistic football sounds
+ 12 skins including 2 that are FREE!
+ Multiplayer fun 2-8 players!

items.title: Masked Halloween Suits
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
The spooky season has arrived! Choose your favorite skin for Halloween and go trick-or-treating! You'll love all the skins in this pack!

+ 12 skins including 2 that are FREE!
+ Halloween themed
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Elegant Outfits
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Are you ready to shine with the most elegant outfits? The skins in this pack are so cool and cute! Choose your favorite one and show off your elegance to other players!

+ 12 skins including 2 that are FREE!
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Trendy Hoodies
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Do you like to wear hoodies? If so, this pack is perfect for you! Choose your favorite cool and sweet skin now and amaze other players!

+ 12 skins including 2 that are FREE!
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Back to School Teens
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
It's time to go back to school and see all your friends again! The fun doesn't stop after summer, so pick a stylish school outfit and have fun with your buddies!

- 8 AWESOME skins
- Licensed by UniDesigns and published by BLOCKLAB Studios.
